posts.name: Sonu kumar
posts.cooked:
@sayan @22f3000671 sir i have one doubt ,
i am repeating oppe this term. Can I solve the programming assignment of the portal?it would not affect the assignment score of prev term, right?

posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Yes you can practise, it will not affect the programming score.

Also, remember you have to again solve BPTs to be eligible for OPPE this term. However, the BPT score from previous term willl be considered for calculating the final score and course grade.

Thank you.

posts.name: Sonu kumar
posts.cooked:
Thanks for clarifying
yes i know about bpt ,i saw that part in document .i have one more doubt when i tried to make another vm with same ssh key then it is still giving me old vm(where bpt soln is already present ) so do i need to create another ssh key to make new vm

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: You cannot make new vm. VMs are provided my course team. And ssh keys are just “keys” to access that vm, even if you generate new key, vm will be the same.

posts.name: Sonu kumar
posts.cooked:
so how would i solve BPT as it is already solved and present in that vm ?
do i need to delete that

image1639×616 43.3 KB

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Yes. You’ll have to delete those scripts and solve again.
